composition_notes: Isolated bell attacks occupy different registers; the silence between attacks is part of the phrase.
The registral gaps and notated silences remain structural. Bell gestures keep their pitch-class contour, with coherent register routes rather than accidental bar-to-bar jumps.
The score records each added suspension and scalar connection explicitly for teaching.
The free preludes are reviewed for note integrity, spelling, harmonic context and the listed voice-leading changes; they are not advertised as strict-species exercises.
